entries.reason: Accounting correction only, not matching progress (owner ruling 2026-09-27, 'Denominator correction'). January's linker pools every COMMON record and two linker-generated .rdata records into one '* Linker *' contribution (PDB module 847), which config lists as the Halo unit source/linker_common. 27 of its records are vendor COMMON (their XDK library members define them COMMON and January links those members) and 2 are the linker's debug directory and CodeView record; this moves their objdiff-3.3.1 extents (1,125 + 88 raw bytes, 1,192 + 96 as objdiff sizes them) out of the Halo data denominator. Halo COMMON (213 records) stays in halobetacache; the All denominator, matched bytes, functions, units and verdicts are unchanged. Q10 remains held: this entry earns and removes no credit.
